title: Go Fast is a wind-blown balloon

tellings.quote: So my hypothesis about this one is that it's uh probably just a windb blown object like a balloon.

plain: Mick West, a skeptic who studies UFO videos, talks about "Go Fast", a 2015 Navy video filmed off Jacksonville, Florida, that seems to show a small object racing low over the ocean. On Jesse Michels's podcast he says his best guess is that it is just something carried by the wind, like a balloon, and only looks fast because of how the camera views it. If he is right, the video shows nothing unusual.
